title: Development of a Multicellular Three-dimensional Organotypic Model of the Human Intestinal Mucosa Grown Under Microgravity
protocol: Unscrew the cap of the fill port of the 50 ml-vessel and fill with 50 ml of sterile culture medium (e.g., RPMI).
Perform all procedures under sterile conditions in a laminar hood.
Replace the cap and wipe any spilled medium on any surface with 70% ethanol.
Allow the vessel to incubate for at least 15 min to O/N at RT.
Use the fill port to discard the culture medium and add 30 ml of 3-D culture medium.
Wipe any spilled medium on any surface with 70% ethanol.
Culture cells in Basal Eagle's medium enriched with supplement 1.
Split cells at a ratio of 1:3 when confluent.
Culture HUVEC cells in Endothelial Basal Medium (EBM) enriched with 100 μg/ml heparin, 3 μg/ml ECGS, and supplement 1.
Split HUVEC cells at a ratio of 1:2 when confluency reaches 70%.
Isolate PBMC from blood by density gradient centrifugation using standard techniques.
Dilute blood with Phosphate Buffered Saline (PBS) at a 1:1 ratio.
Carefully layer diluted blood over density centrifugation media in a tube.
Centrifuge the sample to separate cells based on density.
Collect lymphocytes and monocytes from the "white" layer between density centrifugation media and plasma layers using a transfer pipette.
Wash collected PBMC.
Use or cryopreserve PBMC as needed.
Determine the number of inserts needed based on the experimental conditions.
Place the appropriate number of inserts into the wells of a 6-well plate.
Wash the flasks twice in PBS.
Detach cells using trypsin, 0.25% (1x) with 0.05% trypsin-tetrasodium ethylenediaminetetraacetate (Trypsin-EDTA).
Add enough trypsin solution to cover the entirety of the cell culture surface area.
Collect detached cells in a 50 ml tube containing 30 ml of DMEM-30% FBS medium.
Centrifuge the tube at 500 x g for 10 min.
Resuspend the cells in 30 ml of DMEM-30% FBS medium.
Dilute 20 μl of resuspended cells with 20 μl of Trypan blue dye.
Load the hemocytometer with the cell mixture.
Count the total number of viable cells using a hemocytometer.
Resuspend each cell type in DMEM-30% FBS medium at a concentration of 5 - 8 x 10^7 cells ml^-1.
Prepare cell-containing collagen gels.

Prepare the collagen mixture by adding 1 x DMEM media supplemented with gentamicin, L-glutamine, FBS, bovine collagen-I, laminin, collagen IV, fibronectin, heparin sulfate proteoglycan, and NaOH to a 50 ml-conical tube.
Mix the components in the tube by inverting several times until fully homogenized.
Keep the mixture on ice to prevent gelification.
If the mixture appears acidic (yellowish), add sterile 1 N NaOH drops to neutralize it.
Add concentrated HUVEC and fibroblasts at densities of 1.0 - 1.2 x 10^6 cells/ml and 1.5 - 2.0 x 10^6 cells/ml, respectively, to the collagen mixture.
Mix by inverting the tubes several times until fully homogenized.
Keep this cell-containing collagen mixture on ice to prevent gelification.
Add 4 - 5 ml of the cell-containing collagen gel to each insert loaded into a 6 well-plate.
Allow the gel to set in the hood with minimal movement for 1 hour.
Transfer the 6-well plate to a 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 1 - 2 additional hours.
Return the 6-well plate to the hood.
Aseptically cut-off the membrane from the insert with sterile forceps and scalpel, detaching the cell-containing gel from the membrane.
Cut the detached gel into small squares (~5 x 5 mm).
Add the small cell-containing squares into a 50-ml HARV using the fill port.
Wash the flasks twice in PBS.
Detach the cells using trypsin, 0.25% (1x) with Trypsin-EDTA treatment.
Collect detached cells in 30 ml of DMEM-30% FBS medium.
Centrifuge DMEM-30% FBS medium containing tube at 500 x g for 10 min.
Resuspend the cells in 30 ml of DMEM-30% FBS medium.
Count the total number of viable cells as described in 3.2.5.
Resuspend the HCT-8 epithelial cells in DMEM-30% FBS medium at a concentration of 107 cells/ml-1.
Add 1 ml of the concentrated HCT-8 epithelial cells into the 50-ml HARV using the fill port.
By using the fill port, add additional 3-D culture medium until the vessel is nearly full (~20 ml).
Replace the cap and wipe the lip of the fill port with 70% ethanol.
Place a syringe in each syringe port of the RWV: place a 5 ml-syringe containing 3 - 4 ml of 3-D culture medium in one port and a 5 ml-empty syringe in the other port.
Remove any visible bubbles from the solution using a syringe.
Place the vessels in the bioreactor, turn on the power, and set the speed to about 13 to 14 rotations per minute.
Culture cells at 37 °C and 5% CO2 under microgravity conditions provided by the RWV bioreactor.
Change culture medium every 3 to 4 days by replacing approximately 30 ml with fresh 3-D culture medium.
After 4 days, remove the vessels from the bioreactor and add lymphocytes/monocytes (2 x 10^7/vessel).
Place the vessels back in the bioreactor at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for an additional 5 days.
On day 9 of the culture, add another 2 x 10^7 lymphocytes/monocytes to the vessels.
Continue the cultures for up to 12 additional days, changing the medium every 3 to 4 days as necessary.
Harvest each small gel fragment into a six-well plate containing 10 ml of 10% formalin buffer using a transfer pipette.
Leave the constructs in the formalin buffer for 3 hours at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C.
Prepare tissue processing and embedding cassettes by labeling them and adding two pieces of biopsy foam pads into each cassette.
Immerse the cassettes in 10% formalin buffer.
Place the fixed-constructs between the two foam pads using forceps.
Immerse the cassettes in 10% formalin buffer again.
Proceed with standard procedures for embedding, sectioning, and staining.
